text: Taisho Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. is the principal operating subsidiary of Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings Co., Ltd., which was taken private by the founding Uehara family in an April 2024 management buyout and delisted from the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
short: Taisho Pharmaceutical is the operating subsidiary of Taisho Pharmaceutical Holdings.
